2609.27467.title: Kairos: Grounded Forecasting of Presence and Directional Flow in 4D Scene Graphs
2609.27467.paper_summary: Long-term autonomy in human-populated environments requires anticipating whether and how people will move at times a robot has not yet observed. Existing representations of pedestrian motion face a tradeoff: they either forecast future activity, reducing each location to a scalar rate, or model the full directional distribution, holding it fixed in time. We present Kairos, a predictive directional-flow memory that extends a hierarchical 3D scene graph (3DSG) to a 4D scene graph (4DSG). Every observed voxel of the reconstructed geometry stores a directional mixture and a presence rate, and spectral predictors forecast, for any future query time, both the probability that people are present and the full directional distribution of their motion. Pairwise flow dependence between adjacent voxels supports conditional queries, and per-voxel predictive variances yield calibrated credible intervals that tighten as observations accumulate. We evaluate Kairos on three real pedestrian environments: a robot-collected campus dataset, a shopping mall, and a station concourse recorded continuously for eleven months. Its learned state remains consistent under loop-closure corrections, and its forecasts are competitive with dedicated occupancy and flow models trained on the full detection stream, although Kairos learns from only the small fraction available to a patrolling robot. Finally, we validate the representation on a downstream encounter-probability planning task, where plans computed over the Kairos forecasts encounter more people than plans computed over any time-invariant map at an equal success rate. We provide the code at https://github.com/IacopomC/kairos.
2609.27467.paper_summary_zh: 長期在有人居住的環境中自主行動需要預測人們在機器人尚未觀察到的時候是否以及如何移動。現有的行人運動表示面臨一個權衡：它們要麼預測未來活動，將每個位置簡化為一個標量速率，要麼建模完整的方向分佈，並將其固定在時間上。我們提出了Kairos，一種預測性方向流記憶，將層次化的3D場景圖（3DSG）擴展到4D場景圖（4DSG）。每個觀察到的重建幾何體的體素都存儲著一個方向混合和一個存在率，光譜預測器預測在任何未來查詢時間，人們存在的概率和他們運動的完整方向分佈。相鄰體素之間的成對流依賴支持條件查詢，而每個體素的預測方差產生經過校準的可信區間，隨著觀察的累積而收緊。我們在三個真實的行人環境中評估Kairos：一個機器人收集的校園數據集、一個購物中心，以及一個連續錄製了十一個月的車站大廳。其學習狀態在環路閉合修正下保持一致，其預測與在完整檢測流上訓練的專用佔用和流模型相當，儘管Kairos僅從巡邏機器人可用的少量數據中學習。最後，我們在一個下游的遇見概率規劃任務中驗證了該表示，在該任務中，基於Kairos預測計算的計劃遇到的人數比基於任何時間不變地圖計算的計劃在相同成功率下更多。我們提供代碼於 https://github.com/IacopomC/kairos。
